thesis: No new-entry capacity route, but the day-ahead market pays almost twice what the platform carried. An uncontracted four-hour project returns 7.4%, and every design still sits below the platform's yields. A project in the 2025 grant cohort returns 17.1%; an asset holding an earlier seventeen-year contract is worth pricing only below replacement cost.
没有新进入的容量路径，但日前市场的收益几乎是本平台此前所采用水平的两倍。无合同的四小时项目回报7.4%，所有设计仍低于本平台收益率。2025年补贴批次中的项目回报17.1%；持有早期十七年合同的资产，只值得以低于重置成本的价格定价。

reason: Seventh of fifteen markets on hold IRR, 7.4%.
持有期IRR为7.4%，在十五个市场中排第七。

reason: The statute sets the fee, the advance, the security and a deadline of 120 to 150 days for an operator to issue connection conditions, and says when a refused applicant is repaid. No single public register follows a storage project from application to operation.
法律明确规定了申请费、预付款、履约担保，以及运营商出具并网条件的120至150日期限，并规定了申请被拒时的退款方式。但没有一个统一的公开登记册能够跟踪储能项目从申请到投运的全过程。

trendCause: The availability factor applied to storage in the capacity auction was cut from 95% to about 60% and then to 13.39% in successive auctions, and no main auction is planned for 2026.

reason: The December 2025 auction was the last main-auction route and its successor framework has no settled design; the factor that sets what a battery is paid for capacity changed sharply between consecutive auctions.
2025年12月的拍卖是最后一轮主拍卖，接续框架的方案尚未确定；决定电池容量收入的修正系数在相邻两轮拍卖之间大幅变动。

Capacity market · 4h · ready-to-build
容量市场 · 4小时 · 具备开工条件
why: Four hours on an earlier seventeen-year capacity contract is the engine's best design at 9.8% hold, and it still loses value at the platform's yields; an uncontracted four-hour project returns 7.4%.
持有早期十七年容量合同的四小时设计是引擎的最佳设计，持有期回报9.8%，但按本平台收益率仍损失价值；无合同的四小时项目回报7.4%。

text: Wait for a successor to the main auctions; until then, price only assets holding an earlier seventeen-year contract, and only below replacement cost.
等待主拍卖的后继机制；在此之前，只对持有早期十七年合同的资产定价，且仅以低于重置成本的价格。

why: The 169 projects in NFOŚiGW's 2025 storage cohort carry a 37.9% average grant (PLN 3.735bn of grants on PLN 9.847bn of cost); merchant four hours with that grant returns 17.1% hold.
国家环保基金2025年储能批次的169个项目平均补贴比例为37.9%（总成本PLN 98.47亿、补贴PLN 37.35亿）；按此补贴，四小时市场化设计持有期回报17.1%。

text: List cohort projects from the NFOŚiGW ranking list of 12 December 2025 whose owners might sell before the end-2028 completion deadline, and check which also hold a capacity contract, since a grant reduces that payment.
从国家环保基金2025年12月12日排名清单中，列出业主可能在2028年底完工期限前出售的批次项目，并核查哪些同时持有容量合同，因为补贴会减少该项付费。

where: A project in NFOŚiGW's 2025 grant cohort
国家环保基金2025年补贴批次中的项目

text: With the cohort's 37.9% grant, merchant four hours returns 17.1% hold and is worth about $200k per MW at the platform's yields.
按该批次37.9%的补贴，四小时市场化设计持有期回报17.1%，按本平台收益率每MW价值约20万美元。
The round is awarded and the grants are signed; completion is due by the end of 2028.
本轮补贴已授予并签约；须于2028年底前完工。

despite: Merchant revenue carries the whole case, and the curve that compresses it is fitted on Bulgaria, not Poland.
整个投资逻辑由市场化收入支撑，而压缩该收入的曲线是依据保加利亚而非波兰拟合的。
